externalHF(address).details: The Aave version of 1 / LTV is used in this implementation.

returns.extHF: health factor from external protocol's perspective (1 / LTV).
returns.externalBorrowDebtValue: external borrow value in targetVault unitOfAccount (usually USD).
returns.inHF: health factor of from Twyne's perspective (1 / LTV).
returns.internalBorrowDebtValue: internal borrow value in targetVault unitOfAccount (usually USD).

internalHF(address).details: The Aave version of 1 / LTV is used in this implementation.

positionStats(address).details: Additive view. Mirrors the same on-chain math as health()/internalHF()/externalHF(); no protocol math is re-implemented off this contract. Field order is load-bearing — the Python bot unpacks PositionStats by position.

returns.s: populated PositionStats. Native fields are in cv.asset()/target-asset units; *Usd fields are 1e18; *LTV fields are basis points vs MAXFACTOR (1e4).

externalHF(address).notice: Check health factor from external protocol's perspective (excluding internal borrow).HealthFactor's interpretation depends on the underlying protocol. On Aave = 1 / LTV, On Compound = debt_value - (liq_cf * collateral_value).

health(address).notice: Return health factors and debt values.

internalHF(address).notice: Check health factor from from Intermediate vault's perspective.

positionStats(address).notice: Return the full position bundle (collateral, debt, LTVs, health factors).
